name: oculus
description: Open-source collections platform for archives, museums and historical societies.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @oculus/core && npm run build -w @oculus/db && npm run build -w @oculus/service && npm run build -w @oculus/api && npm run build -w @oculus/admin
scripts.db:backup: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/db/tsconfig.build.json && exec node packages/db/dist/backup-cli.js backup
scripts.db:restore: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/db/tsconfig.build.json && exec node packages/db/dist/backup-cli.js restore
scripts.db:cleanup: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/db/tsconfig.build.json && exec node packages/db/dist/cleanup-cli.js
scripts.setup: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/db/tsconfig.build.json && exec node packages/db/dist/setup-cli.js
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run e2e -w @oculus/admin
